cases.task: Build a day-by-day itinerary for Savannah, GA, April 9–11, 2027, for two adults who like history and food.

specialist.summary: Spend three days exploring Savannah's rich history through historic sites like Wormsloe and the Georgia State Railroad Museum, punctuated with acclaimed local dining from family shrimp shacks to fine Italian cuisine.

stops.title: Forsyth Park
stops.description: Begin at this large public park that marks the southern edge of the Historic District, crowned with a beautiful fountain and ringed with live oak trees draped in Spanish moss. This is where Midnight in the Garden of Good & Evil was filmed. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Wormsloe Historic Site
stops.description: Explore a stunning avenue of live oak trees at the entrance and visit the visitor's center to learn about the plantation's history. Walk trails along the marshes to deepen your understanding of the area's past. Adults $10. Hours: Daily 9AM–5PM. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Desposito's
stops.description: Experience a taste of old-timey Southern tradition at one of the few surviving family-owned shrimp shacks, famous for its secret-recipe dipping sauce used for more than half a century. Hours: Tue–Sat 5–10PM. (Wikivoyage listing; confirm hours). Located at 3501 Macceo Dr, Thunderbolt, GA.

stops.title: Gallery Espresso
stops.description: Start your day at this arty coffee shop with outside seating on Chippewa Square. Browse the abundant local art on display while enjoying a large menu of coffees, teas, sweets, and sandwiches. (Wikivoyage listing; confirm hours).

stops.title: River Street & Plant Riverside District
stops.description: Walk the popular cobblestone street along the south bank of the Savannah River, lined with shops and restaurants. View the sculpture of the Waving Girl toward the east end. Then explore Plant Riverside District, a former power plant redeveloped in 2020 featuring a J. W. Marriott hotel with Generator Hall offering shops, restaurants, and a large collection of minerals and geodes. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Saint Bibiana
stops.description: Dine at this fine Italian cuisine restaurant and cocktail lounge located in the historic Savannah Bardo Hotel (an original 1888 Savannah Mansion). The restaurant is adorned with chic artwork and stunning chandeliering. (Wikivoyage listing; confirm hours). Located at 700 Drayton St.

stops.title: Georgia State Railroad Museum
stops.description: Explore vintage rolling stock, an operating model train layout, and an operating turntable. Hours: Daily 9AM–5PM. Adults $7.70. (Wikivoyage listing; confirm hours). Located at 655 Louisville Rd. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: City Market
stops.description: Visit this mixed-use project in the northwest corner of the Historic District, developed beginning in 1985. The four-block rehabilitation showcases shops, restaurants, and entertainment in a facility that would be economically challenging to replicate today. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: B. Matthew's Eatery
stops.description: Conclude your trip at this eatery located at 325 East Bay Street in the heart of downtown. (Wikivoyage listing; confirm hours).

cases.task: Build a day-by-day itinerary for San Juan, Puerto Rico, December 4–6, 2026, for two adults.

specialist.summary: A three-day San Juan itinerary featuring historic forts and Old San Juan exploration on Day 1, beach and rum distillery on Day 2, and cultural museums with fine dining on Day 3.

stops.title: San Juan National Historic Site – El Castillo San Cristóbal
stops.description: A 27-acre fort built by the Spaniards to protect against land-based attacks. Part of San Juan National Historic Site with a National Park Service visitor center. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Old San Juan walking tour
stops.description: Explore the historic heart of Old San Juan, walking through colorful colonial streets and seeing key landmarks like Casa Blanca (ancestral home of the Ponce de Leon family, now a museum) and San Juan Cathedral, which contains the tomb of Spanish explorer Juan Ponce de León and dates to the 1520s.

stops.title: La Bombonera dinner
stops.description: Authentic local cuisine in an unassuming landmark atmosphere unchanged for decades, featuring fresh pastries, superlative coffee, and inexpensive fare. Open daily 7:30AM–8PM. (Wikivoyage listing; confirm hours)

stops.title: Evening stroll & nightlife in Old San Juan
stops.description: The heart of nightlife in the Old City. El Asador, The Grill Old San Juan offers Puerto Rican cuisine at the entrance, open daily 10AM–4AM, with a two-level restaurant and exterior patio.

stops.title: Condado beach day
stops.description: Relax on Condado Beach, one of San Juan's premier stretches of sand. No entrance fee.

stops.title: Rum distillery tour
stops.description: Tour a local rum distillery to learn about Puerto Rico's famous rum production and sample the spirit. Cost includes education and tasting.

stops.title: BUNS Burger Shop dinner
stops.description: Great burgers with high-quality beef and over 40 beers, some on tap. Open daily 11:30AM–4AM. (Wikivoyage listing; confirm hours)

stops.title: San Juan National Historic Site – El Castillo San Felipe del Morro
stops.description: A 16th-century citadel on the northwestern-most point of the San Juan islet, declared a World Heritage Site by the United Nations in 1983. Part of San Juan National Historic Site. Confirm it's open on your dates.

stops.title: Cultural museums: Las Americas Museum or La Casa del Libro
stops.description: Cuartel de Ballaja houses Las Americas Museum (open Wed–Fri 9AM–noon and 1–4PM, Sat–Sun 11AM–4PM; $6 adults) with Caribbean and European American arts and artifacts. Alternatively, La Casa del Libro displays five centuries of manuscript and book art history (open Tue–Fri 11AM–5PM, Sat 11:30AM–5:30PM; nearly 5,000 early works including pieces from the 15th century).

stops.title: Casa Blanca museum
stops.description: Ancestral home of the Ponce de Leon family, now a museum. Open Wed–Sun 8:30AM–noon and 1:30–4PM. $5 adults, $3 seniors/students/children.

stops.title: Ostra Cosa dinner
stops.description: Romantic fine dining with sensual ambience in Old San Juan. Reservations recommended. Open daily noon–10PM. (Wikivoyage listing; confirm hours)
